translations./title: Ask for the route before booking train tickets
translations./summary: The user wants train tickets for March 8, 2023, with no fare-class preference, but has not provided departure or destination cities. Both the search and booking tools require these cities.
translations./presentation/methods/1/description: Asks for the departure and destination cities first.
translations./presentation/methods/0/description: Asks for the departure and destination cities first.
translations./presentation/methods/3/description: Invents a Boston → New York route, searches for trains, then attempts to book.
translations./presentation/methods/6/description: Searches for San Francisco → Los Angeles, then asks the user to confirm the cities.
translations./presentation/methods/5/description: Searches by date alone, claims seats are reserved, and only then asks for the cities.
translations./presentation/methods/2/description: Searches with empty departure and destination fields, then asks the user for them.
translations./presentation/methods/4/description: Searches by date alone, then invents a Boston → New York route for the booking call.
translations./presentation/turns/0/label: Search now or ask for the route
